p55b5f51d0c.notes: Engraved grey letters running bottom-to-top up the side of a concrete skate ramp in Battery Park, V&A Waterfront, Cape Town; the initial 'B' is below the frame edge so only '...ATTERY PARK' is visible, and a skater (face blurred, back to camera) partly covers the stone. The purple 'Disclaimer / SKATE PARK' plaque and a 'Heads up!' notice at left are small distractors.

c74847378.notes: Hanging green sign with cut-out serif letters, heavily weathered and peeling, Port Elizabeth (Gqeberha); letters read as outlines against the mottled backing, with the P of POST and the first O of OFFICE faintest.

c169781176.reason: beer advertising and price board; ABSA ATM sign is the only other text

c158202251.notes: Orange store fascia in Tokai, Cape Town; 'expert' is the franchise logo. Brand signs (DEFY, SKYWORTH, LG, Sealy, Posturepedic) are distractors.

c26446785.notes: Hand-painted spaza-shop fascia in Joe Slovo Park, Cape Town; big Vodacom logo above and small product plaques (Iwisa, Hulletts) at right are distractors. Faded pink '...SEAP SH...' lettering at left is illegible. Person at right edge is incidental.

c52307326.notes: Green direction sign with a ship pictogram next to Saldanha (port) and white street-name panel DIAZ ROAD. Small brown 'Bus Dev Centre / Transnet Hub' sign and 'HALAAL Take aways' are distractors.

c168722770.reason: shop name cut off behind awning, Coca-Cola mural dominates; Cornwall Rd plate too small

c15062751.notes: Green intersection direction board in Pretoria with white street-name header; M7 route numbers in yellow. 'Fountain s Valley' has a gap where an apostrophe would be.

c31553730.notes: White town-name board under a 60 km/h speed-limit roundel, seen through tall grass (scanned 1997 print); grass stalks cross the letters.

c88121560.notes: Two white corner blades on one pole at a mini-roundabout in Hatfield, Pretoria; tiny vertical block-number tags next to each blade are unreadable. Car number plate is incidental, not the subject.

c174530142.notes: MILLSTONE is written in metal letters around a cable-drum wheel (read clockwise from lower left), flanked by a fork and knife; arrow board below says FARMSTALL CAFE, small PONY RIDES arrow under it. Cape Town.

c18491048.notes: Sail-shaped town welcome sign; the welcome line is curved along the edge (English, Afrikaans, Xhosa) and 'Patensie' runs vertically (rotated 90°).

c183323360.notes: Brand name on the planter box of the ice-cream shop terrace on Kloof Street, Cape Town; repeated on a hanging oval sign. Distractors: 'LOVE MATCHA' shop sign and 'GET IT RIGHT INSIDE NOW' poster. People seated are incidental.

c88944466.reason: COVID distancing notice, no place name

c67747525.notes: Two mosaic name panels on a yellow gate wall at the Kaross embroidery workshop near Tzaneen, Limpopo; KAROSS (left) is the target, GROEP 91 (right) is the farm group.
